Travel time estimated from the distance. Map data:
Reminds at the first branch you arrive at
Your usual place for “%1$s”, chosen %2$d times so far. Tap the place to take another one.
Choose a place on the map
Tap the map to set the point. Give the place a name.
Map: set the place with a tap
Your phone reminds as soon as it arrives at the place or leaves it. The server does not learn where you are.

For the search only the search word and your position rounded to about one kilometre go to your GateControl server, which asks a map service of OpenStreetMap. Your name, your device and your exact location are not sent.
The place search on the internet is switched off. Remembered places and the map keep working.
The map service cannot be reached right now. Remembered places and the map keep working.
Too many searches right now – please try again in a moment.
A place to search near is missing: allow the location or save a place first.
Without a connection to the server nothing can be searched. Remembered places and the map keep working.
When your phone passes another place of the kind “%1$s”, the task speaks up there as well.
The place was set by someone else. Your phone only watches it once you agree.
Waiting for consent: the phone of the person in charge only watches the place after that.
The reminder at the place was declined. The task stays without it.
Needs the place search: “%1$s” only reminds once the place search on the internet is switched on.
This phone does not remind at the place yet. For that GateControl needs the location, also in the background (“Allow all the time”). Showing and changing places works without it.
This phone cannot remind at a place: it has no Google Play services. Showing and changing places still works.
This phone may remind at a place.

For reminders at a place GateControl uses your precise location on this phone to notice when you arrive at the place of a task or leave it. The phone checks that itself. Your exact location never goes to your GateControl server – only, while the place search is switched on, a position rounded to about one kilometre, so that it can name fitting places near you.

Reminders at a place also work while GateControl is closed or not in use: for that GateControl collects your location in the background through Android’s geofencing. The server only learns that a place fired – and, while the place search is switched on, after you moved a longer way the position rounded to about one kilometre. Choose “Allow all the time” on the next page.
To find places near you GateControl uses your location. Only the search word and the position rounded to about one kilometre go to your GateControl server; the phone works out the distances itself.
For “which DIY store is near?”. Off: no search leaves the server for you; remembered places and the map keep working.
Switched off by the administrator (Settings › Plugins › Notes & Tasks › Places).
The place search is not set up yet (own map service without an address).
When your phone passes another fitting place (another DIY store), the task speaks up there as well – at most once in three hours per task.
No hint on the way during this time. The reminder at the chosen place always comes.
“%1$s” will no longer be among “My places”. Tasks that hang on the place keep it.
This card is made on the phone. The server does not learn where you are.
The place needs a connection to the server.
What is still waiting is sent first – then the place can be changed.
This place is no longer offered for the task.
Only the person whose phone is to watch the place can agree.
100 places are saved already. Delete one first.
